page.overview:
Who is Kadasha?

Mariana (stepmother) Mateo (stepbrother) Unnamed Half-brother}}

Kadasha is an African-American child part of a mixed family from Oakland, California.

Kadasha was portrayed by American actress Melody Hurd in the 2019 short film Battle at Big Rock.

Kadasha was born in Oakland, California to Dennis and an unknown African-American woman. Through unknown circumstances, Dennis became a single father and raised Kadasha on his own as her guardian. Kadasha grew up to be a curious sort and fascinated by dinosaurs especially after the release of the dinosaurs on the mainland.
